name: Love and longing for a being
description: Someone has fallen in love with a being of the old world, or a being with a person: a farmhand drawn nightly to the forest, a widow who keeps a place set for a lover from the lake, a herd girl at the summer pasture visited by someone too beautiful. It may be a lure, a true and doomed love, or a bargain dressed as romance. The family sees only someone wasting away or slipping from their faith and duty; the lover may not want rescuing.

roleSlots.name: The one who longs
roleSlots.description: The person bewitched or in love, drawn away from home and its people; may be the most sympathetic figure in the case.

roleSlots.name: The one left behind
roleSlots.description: A betrothed, spouse or parent who feels the loss and wants the beloved back at any cost.

roleSlots.name: The jealous rival
roleSlots.description: A suitor or sweetheart who resents the being and may take violent, foolish action against it.

roleSlots.name: The one who arranged it
roleSlots.description: Someone who brought the two together on purpose, to be rid of an unwanted match or for a favour from the old world.

roleSlots.name: The one who has seen them
roleSlots.description: A charcoal burner, fisherman or child who has seen the lovers meet and is not believed.

decoyIdeas: A secret love affair with an unsuitable person from the village, a stranger, or a married man.
Melancholia or the first signs of consumption, as the physician says.
Religious mania stirred up by a revivalist preacher.
